description: Fix two harness doc links that break the site copy

userStories.title: Fix the stale anchor and the bare autolink
userStories.description: As a docs maintainer, I want harness pages that copy to the site unchanged, so that the next docs sync needs no link fix.
acceptanceCriteria: In `docs/intro.md`, the link to the security page uses the anchor `#4-sandbox-isolation--the-docker-socket-caveat--enforced-with-a-caveat`.
In `docs/runtimes/docker.md`, line 29 writes the link as `[https://docs.docker.com/engine/install/](https://docs.docker.com/engine/install/)`.
`git diff --stat origin/development` shows 2 changed lines in 2 files, apart from the task files.
